name: Whispering Meadows
description: A tranquil expanse of soft pastel grass, flat lakes, and gentle flower-covered knolls.

name: Luminescent Wetlands
description: Shallow reflective waters interspersed with low, mossy hummocks and giant glowing mushrooms.

name: Sunfire Savanna
description: Warm rolling steppes dotted with low acacia trees and smooth clay plateaus.

name: Prismatic Badlands
description: Layered sandstone canyons and winding dried riverbeds with moderate terraced cliffs.

name: Frostfang Highlands
description: Steep alpine hills coated in dense pine forests and crisp powder snow.

name: Obsidian Crags
description: Jagged volcanic ridges and abrupt basalt columns towering over lava pools.

name: Aetherial Spires
description: Vertical rock pillars and gravity-defying floating islands suspended above deep chasms.

name: Celestial Peaks
description: Razor-sharp mountain pinnacles that pierce the upper cloud layer with perilous vertical cliffs.
